mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_info (org_id, org_name, emp_count) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{orgName}, #{empCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE org_name = IF(VALUES(org_name) != '', VALUES(org_name), org_name), emp_count = IF(#{empCount} > 0, VALUES(emp_count), emp_count)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT user_org_id FROM user_stage_progress WHERE user_org_id != '' AND deleted_flag = 0 UNION SELECT DISTINCT user_org_id FROM user_step_progress WHERE user_org_id != '' AND deleted_flag = 0

SELECT user_org_id AS orgId, user_org AS orgName FROM user_stage_progress WHERE user_org_id != '' AND user_org != '' AND deleted_flag = 0 GROUP BY user_org_id UNION SELECT user_org_id AS orgId, user_org AS orgName FROM user_step_progress WHERE user_org_id != '' AND user_org != '' AND deleted_flag = 0 GROUP BY user_org_id
SELECT id, org_id, org_name, emp_count, deleted_flag, add_time, create_time, update_time FROM org_info WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND deleted_flag = 0
SELECT emp_count FROM org_info WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND deleted_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
